title: Miss Coles's lawn parties and dance halls
summary: He describes Miss Coles's lawn parties and dance hall, plus St. Elizabeth and St. Dominic Halls, with prices, food and hours.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: You might tell some of the other halls where you used to play or where you heard music when you were young.
There's places where they gave dances up town.
Yeah, Miss Coles. Oh yeah, what kind of, what were they?
Lawn parties, huh? Yeah, that's right.

Well it was a dance hall, you know, that first was lawn parties, years ago, and then she made a dance hall. She did? Yeah, regular big dance hall. Did she build it out in their yard? Build it, build it in that big vacant place where we used to have the, she used to have the lawn parties. Where was that? That was on, on, let's see, on Woola. On Woola and, Woola and Jackson, Jackson Woola. I don't think it was, Jackson Clare or Jackson Woola? Josephine somebody told me it was. Josephine, well between Josephine and Jackson. Well, Willa and Josephine. Willa and Josephine, well that's right, well Jackson the next year, yeah, yeah. So she built a dance hall in there. Yeah, she built a dance hall there. We used to go there when we were just little kids, you know, to lawn parties.
Did they have them every week or night or when?

Yeah, every weekend. No, every weekend. Every weekend. And then, of course the, uh, Miss, uh, let's see, Miss Coles and then also, uh, the, uh, St. Elizabeth Hall. That was on camp in Valens. And then, come the, uh, the, uh, let's see, St. Dominic Hall. St. Dominic Hall. What street that was on again? I forgot.
I want to hear a little bit more about the, Miss Coles. Miss Coles? Did they charge you?
Oh yes, you had to pay fifteen cents. Did they have drinks or anything to eat? Nothing hard to drink, just soft drinks and sandwiches and things like that. You bought that then? Yeah, that's right.
How long were those? But those last three or later they quit pretty early.
No, they quit around three o'clock. Start around eight until about three.
